fields.label: Custom Writer Identity
fields.help: A service account provided by the caller that will be used to write the log entries.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Destination
fields.help: The destination of the sink (or, in other words, where logs are written to).

fields.label: Disabled
fields.help: If set to True, then this sink is disabled and it does not export any log entries.

fields.label: Filter
fields.help: The filter to apply when exporting logs.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name of the logging sink.

fields.label: Project
fields.help: The ID of the project to create the sink in.

fields.label: Unique Writer Identity
fields.help: Whether to use a service agent as the writer_identity for this sink.

fields.label: Bigquery Options
Use Partitioned Tables
fields.help: Whether to use BigQuery's partition tables.
Options that affect sinks exporting data to BigQuery.

fields.label: Exclusions
Disabled
fields.help: If set to True, then this exclusion is disabled and it does not exclude any log entries

fields.label: Filter
fields.help: An advanced logs filter that matches the log entries to be excluded.
Log entries that match any of the exclusion filters will not be exported.
